# DrapixAI

> Product-faithful virtual try-on for fashion brands. DrapixAI prepares and certifies garments before storefront activation, generates Standard upper-body try-ons, and rejects results that fall below publishability thresholds.

## Public documentation

- Developer quickstart: /docs
- Live demo: /demo
- SDK installation: /sdk-install
- Help and troubleshooting: /help
- Service status: /status
- Changelog: /changelog
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## Supported launch scope

Launch-ready focus: shirts, t-shirts, polos, blouses, and clean tops.
Carefully reviewed beta scope: short kurtis, hoodies, and sweatshirts.
The public shopper pipeline uses Standard quality only.

## Browser SDK

Load `/sdk.js` from the DrapixAI web origin. Initialize the SDK with a domain-bound API key and a confirmed product ID. Live products require a prepared garment cache and confirmed product mapping.

Important SDK result metadata includes quality score, confidence badge, latency, warnings, candidate count, garment source, and cache status.

## Quality policy

Confidence badges are Excellent, Review, and Not publishable. Blocking identity, pose, body, garment-color, structure, coverage, artifact, or realism risks cause automatic rejection. Rejected images are not shown to shoppers.

## Privacy

Shopper photos require consent. Retention and deletion behavior is documented on the privacy page. Production integrations should use only HTTPS, verified storefront domains, and protected server-side management routes.
